hero.headline: Understand the product
hero.subline: FlintFlow helps you clarify the idea, write the requirements and check them back the way an experienced BA does. The result is an SRS your dev team and your AI coding tools can both rely on.

facts.phases: 12 phases, every step approved by you

check.title: Three-tier check
check.flags: red flags · {amber} amber flags to review

how.title: A BA's process, split into 12 phases.
how.subline: AI drafts one part at a time. You accept it or ask for changes before anything moves on.

clarify.title: Clarify
clarify.body: Tell us the idea or upload what you already have. FlintFlow only asks about what is still missing.

analyze.title: Analyze
analyze.body: Facts separated from assumptions, contradictions and gaps pointed out. The Brief must be approved before any SRS is written.

specify.title: Specify
specify.body: Use cases, non-functional requirements, use case diagrams and the ERD are drafted one part at a time.

verify.title: Verify
verify.body: Checked against the template, against ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 and on the quality of each requirement. Red flags block the baseline.

modes.title: Start from whatever you already have.

fpt.title: New, on the FPT template
fpt.body: You only have an idea and a few notes. FlintFlow takes you from the Brief to a full SRS on the FPT template.

client.title: On the client's template
client.body: Upload the template your client requires. FlintFlow reads its structure, drafts only the sections it asks for and fills them straight into that file.

existing.title: Revise an existing SRS
existing.body: Import the .docx you already use to see what it is missing. When the client changes a requirement, the edits show up as Track Changes inside the file.

workspace.headline: AI proposes.
workspace.subline: Nothing reaches the document without you: accept it, ask for changes, or take the question back to the client.

crThread.sentText: ✅ {crId} has been written to the shared draft (Track Changes authored by the CR id). Review it on the change request page; to release, submit the whole package to the Lead under Change package.
crThread.sentNext: Type a new edit to open another change request.
crThread.fromPreviewLabel: Create a change request from the preview
crThread.fromPreview: The change request will carry exactly the changes you just previewed. Pick the source and requester to create it; the document changes only after the Lead approves.
crThread.guide: Type an edit request below, e.g. “Add a performance requirement for the search screen”. AI walks you through it step by step: asks about anything missing, points out the related parts, proposes edits for you to accept — then sends them to the Lead for review.
crThread.missingInfoTitle: Some information is missing — AI will make assumptions and flag them on each proposal:
crThread.proposeHint: Go through each part: accept, redo it your way, or drop it. Once all are settled, the system checks them automatically.
crThread.proposeNone: AI found no part that needs editing. Open the list below to bring back any part you still want to edit.
crThread.manualBlockers: AI tried twice and {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} still fail. Redo each one (type a direction right in the card) or drop it — the system re-checks once you are done:
crThread.manualCleared: The failing parts have been redone or dropped. Accept the new proposals, then check again.
crThread.readyText: ✓ All proposals passed the check. Confirm to write them to the shared draft now — the Lead approves the whole package at release.
crThread.readyMore: Want more edits? Keep typing in the chat box — new edits are merged into {crId}.

crWorkspace.draftText: AI reads the request and attached documents, and asks back if anything is vague or missing for writing the content (uses credits).
crWorkspace.impactText: Find every place in the document related to the request (via links between parts, referenced IDs, keywords) and hold them for this CR so no one else edits them at the same time — no credits used.
crWorkspace.proposeRedoText: Some proposals failed the check — AI is self-correcting those locations, attempt {attempt}/{max} (uses credits); still failing after {max} attempts ⇒ fix manually.
crWorkspace.proposeMissedText: AI has not concluded {count, plural, one {# location} other {# locations}}. Run again, or use "Edit manually" on each location below to conclude it yourself.
crWorkspace.proposeText: AI proposes for each location: edit, comment only, or unrelated with a reason (uses credits).
crWorkspace.verifyText: Automatic checks (original content not edited elsewhere, valid data, no new red issues) plus an AI consistency review (yellow warnings only).
crWorkspace.manualText: AI redid it twice and it still fails the check. Fix the failing locations below — “Ask AI to fix by the rules” to have AI rewrite it following that part's authoring rules, or edit it directly — then check again; or cancel the change request.
crWorkspace.readyText: Every location has a conclusion and passed the check. Confirm to write to the shared draft now; mark any location you do not want changed as “not related” first.
crWorkspace.noGroupsText: There are no change groups to review — every location was concluded as "unrelated". Revise the CR to re-conclude each location, or close the CR.
crWorkspace.allRejectedText: Every group was rejected. Revise the CR (re-lock the elements, AI proposes again) or close the CR.
crWorkspace.reviewText: Legacy change request: approve or reject each group. When the last group is decided and at least one is approved ⇒ the changes are written to the draft.
crWorkspace.writtenText: Written to the draft (version {version}) — download the marked-up copy (Track Changes + comments, author {crId}) under Versions; submit the whole package to the Lead under Change package.
crWorkspace.writtenNewText: Written to a new version — download the marked-up copy (Track Changes + comments, author {crId}) under Versions.
crWorkspace.viewerText: You are viewing as a Viewer — only a Lead or Analyst can act on change requests.

crWorkspace.cancelDescription: Cancelling unlocks every block the CR holds. Nothing is written to the document.

codes.INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT: Not enough credit for this AI step — top up and try again.
codes.SPINE_VERSION_CONFLICT: The data was just changed in another session — reloaded, please try again.
codes.PROJECT_MODE_MISMATCH: This project is not an SRS upload project (mode 1).
codes.IMPORT_STAMP_FOREIGN_PROJECT: This file was exported from another project — it cannot be imported into this one.
codes.IMPORT_NEEDS_LATEST_CONFIRM: Please confirm this is the latest version first.
codes.CR_REQUIRES_BASELINE: Finish the import (baseline 0.1) before creating a change request.
codes.RELEASE_RED_FLAGS_OPEN: There are unresolved red flags — cannot release yet.
codes.CR_VALUE_CHANGED: The item was edited elsewhere after the proposal — rerun the proposal, then check again.
codes.CORE_STEP_REQUIRED: This step always runs or already has data — it cannot be turned off.
codes.STEP_NOT_IN_PLAN: The step is not in the project's plan.
codes.BASELINE_BLOCKED: There are unresolved red flags — baseline v1 cannot be signed yet.
codes.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The AI server refused the request (quota exceeded, no billing attached, or calls too fast). Check the AI provider account and try again.
codes.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI server failed or returned nothing — try again; if it keeps happening, check the server log.
codes.MODE1_NO_STEPS: SRS upload projects do not run steps — edit the document via a change request.
codes.MODE1_NO_SIGNOFF: SRS upload projects do not sign baseline v1 — release once there are no red flags.
codes.MODE1_NO_WAIVE: SRS upload projects cannot waive flags — resolve flags with a change request.
codes.IMPORT_REUPLOAD_NO_STAMP: The file does not carry this project's stamp — only files downloaded from FlintFlow can be compared.
codes.CR_NO_OWNER_STEP: This location belongs to a custom section with no authoring rules for the AI — use “Edit directly”.
codes.PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The preview has expired — click “Preview changes” again.
codes.CR_NOTHING_TO_APPROVE: Every location is "not related", so there is nothing to approve. Change the conclusion of a location that needs editing ("Edit manually" button), or cancel the change request.

importWizard.unknownKindNote: FlintFlow is not sure this file is an SRS: few familiar sections (Use Case, Requirements…). It can still be read, but review the extraction carefully at the confirmation step before moving on.
importWizard.formatNote: FlintFlow does not modify your file: the document is read and reprinted in the same order and with the same section headings as the original, but Word formatting is not kept (fonts, styles, header/footer, logo). Readable diagrams are redrawn; missing FPT template sections are added. The original file can always be downloaded again.

baseline.title: Create baseline 0.1 and check
baseline.body: Record the confirmed fields as the index, save the original document as version 0.1, then run checks: AI reviews semantics (yellow flags, costs credit) and deterministic rules (red/yellow flags). Results go to the gap report.
baseline.interrupted: Creating the original version was interrupted — data has been restored to before this step. Click Continue to run it again.
baseline.running: Creating the original version and checking the document…
baseline.runningChecking: Original version 0.1 created, now checking (AI + rules).
baseline.runningWriting: Writing data, drawing diagrams and creating version 0.0.
baseline.runningHint: Large documents can take a few minutes — you can leave this page, the work keeps running.

done.body: Import complete — the document is now version 0.0. Upload copies edited outside FlintFlow in the Document & versions tab to see the differences.

mappingReview.title: Confirm heading → section mapping
mappingReview.summary: {headings} headings, {low} rows with confidence below {threshold}. “Unmatched” headings are kept verbatim and no fields are extracted from them.
mappingReview.provisionalHint: “New feature” / “New function”: features and functions taken from the file's own headings (shown after the “—”); feature and function codes are assigned after the import finishes.
mappingReview.family: Detected: {family, select, ieee830 {IEEE 830 template} ieee_features {IEEE template (System Features style)} other {FPT template}}
mappingReview.familyNote: each section is extracted into the matching FPT section; the document keeps the file's own layout.
mappingReview.noLowRows: No low-confidence rows — review quickly, then confirm.
mappingReview.detectedBy: Detected by {by, select, style {heading style} outline_level {outline level} numbering_pattern {section number} other {your choice}}
mappingReview.sharedSection: Also extracted into “{section}” with: {others} — this heading's content is still printed under it.
mappingReview.tablesHint: Tables with all the required columns are captured automatically at no credit cost. Each table captures one kind of data — choose “Skip this column” if a column has nothing to extract.
mappingReview.mixedEntity: Different kind from the table's other columns — this column will not be captured.

flagsPanel.intro: The document has been imported — every change goes through a change request (created from the gap report, the “Edit document with preview” panel or an edit command in chat). Release is possible once there are no red flags.
flagsPanel.yellowNote: {count, plural, one {# yellow flag} other {# yellow flags}} — not blocking release, see the gap report or the Verification panel.

reviewPackage.title: Change package
reviewPackage.loadFailed: Could not load the change package
reviewPackage.lockedNote: The package is awaiting the Lead — the draft is locked: no new change request can be created or confirmed until the Lead approves the whole package or requests changes.
reviewPackage.changesRequestedNote: The Lead requested changes: “{reason}”. Fix via a new change request (reverting is also a change request), then resubmit.
reviewPackage.empty: No change has been written to the draft since the last release. Every change request the BA confirms lands in this package.
reviewPackage.blockedEmpty: No change request to submit yet.
reviewPackage.blockedRed: {count, plural, one {# red flag} other {# red flags}} still open — resolve via change requests before submitting to the Lead.
reviewPackage.reasonLabel: Reason for requesting changes (at least {min} characters) — the BA will read this
reviewPackage.confirmReleaseQuestion: Approve all {count} changes and release version {version}? A release is immutable — if something is wrong, release a new version.

creditEstimate.none: Estimate: no AI runs needed — the rest is extracted deterministically at no credit cost.
creditEstimate.estimate: {remaining, select, yes {Estimate for the remainder} other {Estimated cost}}: ~{calls} AI runs, ~{credits} credits
creditEstimate.short: Balance too low: extraction will pause when credit runs out. Top up, then click Continue — finished parts are not charged again.

paused.title: {what} is paused — {reason, select, credits {out of credit} interrupted {it was interrupted} other {AI failed after 2 retries}}
paused.creditsBody: Top up credit, then click Continue. Finished work is kept and not charged again.
paused.aiBody: Reserved credit has been refunded. Click Continue to resume from where it stopped, or do it later.

preflight.titleNamed: “{name}” could not be imported — {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} to fix:
preflight.title: The file could not be imported — {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} to fix:

howToFix.LEGACY_DOC: Open it in Word, choose File → Save As → Word Document (.docx).
howToFix.FILE_ENCRYPTED: Remove the password (File → Info → Protect Document), then save.
howToFix.FOREIGN_TRACK_CHANGE: Go to Review → Accept/Reject all changes, then save.
howToFix.FOREIGN_COMMENT: Go to Review → Delete All Comments (or resolve each comment), then save.
howToFix.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Compress the images (File → Compress Pictures) or split off appendices.
howToFix.NOT_SRS: This flow only accepts an SRS or an SRS template (.docx). If this is meeting minutes, an email or notes, attach it in chat as a reference document; if it really is an SRS, make sure it has Use Case / Requirements sections, then upload again.

reupload.prefillIntro: Apply the changes in the re-uploaded file {name} (against version {version}):
reupload.title: Upload a copy edited outside FlintFlow
reupload.hint: Compared block by block with the latest version; no new version is created. To apply the changes, create a change request from the differences.

uploadStep.title: Upload an existing SRS (.docx)
uploadStep.hint: Word .docx file up to {max} MB. Other people's Track Changes/comments must be accepted/rejected before uploading.
uploadStep.tooLarge: File {name} is {size} MB, over the {max} MB limit — compress the images in Word (File → Compress Pictures) or split off appendices, then try again.

confirmLatest.hint: If there is a newer copy elsewhere (email, shared drive…), pick that one instead.

versions.redFlagsOpen: {count, plural, one {# red flag remains} other {# red flags remain}} — resolve via change request before releasing.
versions.releaseHint: Stamps the next major version, locks the baseline and creates a clean copy (all Track Changes accepted). Bundles every change request written since the last release.
versions.confirmQuestion: Release from version {version}? After release, further edits need a new change request.
versions.alreadyReleased: The latest version is already a release and no change request has been written since — releasing again only stamps a new number.
versions.trackedTitle: Track Changes + comments against version {base}, authors {authors}
versions.trackedTitlePrevious: Track Changes + comments against the previous version, authors {authors}
versions.downloadPdfTitle: This Word file converted to PDF

versionCompare.needTwo: At least 2 versions are needed to compare.

readingResult.title: Reading result
readingResult.mapAria: Section map against the target structure

mode.1: The file covers the target structure — {present} sections with content.
mode.3: The fixed template still has {missing} empty sections out of {present} with content. FlintFlow drafts only the sections the template has, adds nothing and keeps the order.
mode.4: The file is missing {missing} sections of the FlintFlow standard template ({present} present). Completing adds the missing sections and reorders the layout, keeping what you have.
